help: write `@test`, `@test(frames: 60)` or `@test(ticks: 60)`, with only the options that note lists for that kind
diagnostics.message: `@test` takes `frames: n` or `ticks: n`, from 1 to 36000: how many of the program's frames, or ticks, run before the test; and may take `input: NAME`, a `std::input::Script` constant of input events for them, or `input: "path"`, a file in the package (a script, or with `ticks` a tick log to check them against)
notes: `@test` alone is a test of code; `@test(frames: 600)` runs the program for 600 frames, then the test with its state; `gpu: true` runs them on the GPU (§13), and `golden: "frame.png", within: 0.5` with it compares the screen after them with that PNG, within a mean difference in 8-bit steps (`pass: "label"`: that pass's target instead), and `hosts: both` runs them in Chrome too, whose last frame and state hash must be the same; `hold: [("far.bin", 120)]` holds the fetches and storage reads of a path until a frame
diagnostics.title: a `@test` that `wrela test` can't run
